notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Added animations and a few Diary notes to make the walkthrough clearer.
Added a new achievement for players who enjoy the Claw Machine.
The Claw Machine is now available also after finishing the game — use it to collect the remaining figurines, which help unlock scenario twists.

notes.content:
- Texts have been improved.
- Graphics have been enhanced — including minigames, inventory items, and location details.
- Some animations have been adjusted for a smoother experience.
- UI improvements for better usability.
- New sounds have been added to enhance the atmosphere.
- The mechanics of the statue minigame have been refined for a more convenient experience.

notes.title: Update for True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle Players
notes.content:
We’ve recently made an important update to the True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle. The issue affecting access to Part 1 has now been resolved for all future buyers.

Unfortunately, several users had already purchased the bundle before we noticed the mistake. If you're one of them and are having trouble accessing Part 1, please reach out to us at support@goblinz.com — we’ll be happy to help. As a token of apology for the inconvenience, we’ll provide a free key to affected players.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Bonus Content:
 - High-resolution wallpapers have been added to the Bonus section.

Bug Fixes:
 - For those who haven't seen it, an issue related to the Playroom and Key has been fixed.
 - Fixed minor mini-game bugs in both the gameplay and Replay sections. Including a bug fix - the final state in the Statues minigame.

Optimization:
 - General performance optimizations have been implemented.

Analytics:
 - New events have been added to support future updates (all data is anonymous).

Text Improvements:
 - Various in-game texts have been improved for clarity and consistency.

Thank you for your continued support!
